description: This file provides an implementation for interacting with ubus (a system bus for embedded Linux systems), including functions for calling ubus methods, handling cache, managing async tasks, and event listening, primarily used within a hardware/software management context.

classes.name: struct dm_ubus_cache_entry
classes.description: Represents a cached ubus response with associated hash for quick lookup.

classes.name: struct dm_ubus_hash_req
classes.description: Holds parameters used for hashing ubus request objects.

classes.name: struct ubus_struct
classes.description: Contains ubus method name and existence flag for dynamic method checks.

methods.name: void prepare_blob_message(struct blob_buf * b,const struct ubus_arg u_args[],int u_args_size)
methods.description: Prepares a blob message for ubus call from an array of arguments.

methods.name: void receive_call_result_data(struct ubus_request * req,int type,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Processes the response data from a ubus call into JSON.

methods.name: int __dm_ubus_call_internal(const char * obj,const char * method,int timeout,struct blob_attr * attr)
methods.description: Performs internal ubus invocation with specified timeout.

methods.name: int __dm_ubus_call(const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * attr)
methods.description: Performs ubus call with default timeout.

methods.name: int __ubus_call_blocking(const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * attr)
methods.description: Performs a blocking ubus call with maximum block time.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_set(const char * obj,const char * method,struct ubus_arg u_args[],int u_args_size)
methods.description: Calls a ubus method and handles the JSON response.

methods.name: void dmubus_listen_timeout(struct uloop_timeout * timeout)
methods.description: Handles ubus listen timeout events.

methods.name: void _bbfdm_task_callback(struct uloop_timeout * t)
methods.description: Callback for scheduled tasks to invoke user-defined callback.

methods.name: int bbfdm_task_schedule(bbfdm_task_callback_t callback,const void * arg1,void * arg2,int timeout_sec)
methods.description: Schedules a task to be run after specified timeout.

methods.name: void _bbfdm_task_finish_callback(struct uloop_process * p,int ret)
methods.description: Callback when a forked process task finishes.

methods.name: int bbfdm_task_fork(bbfdm_task_callback_t taskcb,bbfdm_task_callback_t finishcb,const void * arg1,void * arg2)
methods.description: Forks a process to run a task asynchronously.

methods.name: void dmubus_wait_for_event(const char * event,int timeout,void * ev_data,CB_FUNC_PTR ev_callback,struct dmubus_ev_subtask * subtask)
methods.description: Waits for specific ubus events or timeout.

methods.name: json_object * ubus_call_req(const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * attr)
methods.description: Performs a quick ubus request and returns JSON result.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blob_internal(const char * obj,const char * method,json_object * value,int timeout,json_object ** resp)
methods.description: Internal function to invoke ubus with JSON blob and handle response.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blob(const char * obj,const char * method,json_object * value,json_object ** resp)
methods.description: Performs a ubus call with JSON blob and default timeout.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blob_blocking(const char * obj,const char * method,json_object * value,json_object ** resp)
methods.description: Performs a blocking ubus call with JSON blob.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blob_set(const char * obj,const char * method,json_object * value)
methods.description: Performs a ubus call to set data from JSON blob.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blob_msg_internal(const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_buf * data,int timeout,json_object ** resp)
methods.description: Internal function for invoking ubus with a blob message.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blob_msg_set(const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_buf * data)
methods.description: Sets a ubus blob message.

methods.name: unsigned int djbhash(unsigned hash,const char * data,unsigned len)
methods.description: Hash function for creating hash from request data.

methods.name: unsigned dm_ubus_req_hash_from_blob(const struct dm_ubus_hash_req * req)
methods.description: Creates a hash value from ubus request components using djb2 algorithm.

methods.name: const struct dm_ubus_cache_entry * dm_ubus_cache_lookup(unsigned hash)
methods.description: Searches cache for a given hash.

methods.name: void dm_ubus_cache_entry_new(unsigned hash,json_object * data)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new cache entry.

methods.name: void dm_ubus_cache_entry_free(void)
methods.description: Frees all cache entries.

methods.name: int dmubus_call(const char * obj,const char * method,struct ubus_arg u_args[],int u_args_size,json_object ** req_res)
methods.description: Performs a ubus call with argument array, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: int dmubus_call_blocking(const char * obj,const char * method,struct ubus_arg u_args[],int u_args_size,json_object ** req_res)
methods.description: Performs a blocking ubus call with argument array.

methods.name: void receive_list_result(struct ubus_context * ctx,struct ubus_object_data * obj,void * priv)
methods.description: Callback to process list of ubus objects to check for method existence.

methods.name: bool dmubus_object_method_exists(const char * object)
methods.description: Checks if a method exists on an ubus object.

methods.name: void dm_ubus_init(struct dmctx * bbf_ctx)
methods.description: Initializes ubus context.

methods.name: void dm_ubus_free(struct dmctx * bbf_ctx)
methods.description: Frees ubus cache and context.
